Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. The ex-dividend date was Friday, February 9th. This represents a $2.52 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.46%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is 25.90%.
